description: This file contains utility functions and constants for setting up test resources in the Mattermost server project, including file and directory search, copying, symlinking, and configuration setup.

methods.name: findFile
methods.description: Searches for a file within predefined search paths, returning the full path if found.

methods.name: findDir
methods.description: Searches for a directory within predefined search paths, returning the path and success status.

methods.name: getTestResourcesToSetup
methods.description: Returns a list of test resource details with resolved full paths for setup.

methods.name: CopyFile
methods.description: Copies a file from source to destination using the filestore backend.

methods.name: SetupTestResources
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory and sets up test resources by copying or symlinking files and directories, and sets up configuration.

methods.name: setupConfig
methods.description: Creates a configuration directory, sets default config, and writes it to a JSON file.
